quests.title: The Lost Sunstone of Haven
quests.summary: Scholar Elena seeks the ancient radiant Sunstone buried in the sepulcher of Lord Karas within the Sunken Crypt.

inquire_scholar.description: Speak with Scholar Elena at Haven settlement or locate her research notes.

objectives.text: Consult Scholar Elena about the lost crypt.

explore_crypt.description: Journey to the Sunken Crypt and defeat Lord Karas to recover the Sunstone.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Radiant Sunstone of Haven.

return_or_keep.description: Deliver the Sunstone to Elena for a scholarly reward, or retain it as an artifact of power.

objectives.text: Deliver the relic to Elena or claim its power.

completed.description: The mystery of the Sunstone has been resolved.

onNpcDeath.narrative: With Scholar Elena slain, her research journal reveals the location of the Sunstone in the Sunken Crypt. You may seek the relic for your own glory.

quests.title: The Bristle Boar Menace
quests.summary: Captain Valerius has posted a bounty for hunting ferocious wild boars in the Whispering Woods.

hunt_boar.description: Venture into the Whispering Woods and slay a wild bristle boar.

objectives.text: Defeat a wild boar in the Whispering Woods.

return_captain.description: Report your victory to Captain Valerius in Haven.

completed.description: The boar bounty has been collected.

quests.title: The High Vault Infiltration
quests.summary: Infiltrate Haven's High Vault by picking the lock or obtaining the key, and claim the treasures within.

infiltrate_vault.description: Unlock or pick the High Vault door in Haven.

objectives.text: Loot the gilded strongbox inside the vault.

quests.title: The Secret of the Sunken Grotto
quests.summary: Discover the hidden passage behind the overgrown granite boulder in the Whispering Woods.

discover_grotto.description: Roll aside the monolithic boulder and explore the hidden cavern.

completed.description: The Sunken Grotto has been charted.

quests.title: Lycus' Caravan Contract
quests.summary: Merchant Lycus entrusted you with a sealed parcel for the Haven Watch Post.

active_delivery.description: Carry Lycus' sealed parcel to Captain Valerius at the Haven Watch Post.

objectives.text: Deliver the sealed parcel to Captain Valerius.

return_lycus.description: The Watch has its goods. Collect your fee from Lycus.

objectives.text: Collect your fee from Merchant Lycus.

onNpcDeath.reason: Merchant Lycus was slain. The delivery contract is null and void.

quests.title: Hostage of the Obsidian Crag
quests.summary: A beast-haunted crag holds a captive apprentice artificer. Free them before they are dragged deeper, then report to Captain Valerius.

earlyCompletionBonus.narrative: Rescued the apprentice swiftly before any harm could befall them!

timeMilestones.narrative: Scouts report bandit lookouts have doubled at the Obsidian Crag. Time is growing short!
The deadline expired! The captive has been dragged deeper into the cavern, guarded by heavier reinforcements.

rescue_crag.description: Reach the Obsidian Crags and free the captive apprentice, by force or by stealth.

objectives.text: Free the apprentice at the crags.

stage_hostage_moved.description: The apprentice was dragged into the Sunken Grotto, behind the great boulder in the Whispering Woods. Get in and free them.

objectives.text: Free the apprentice in the Sunken Grotto (past the boulder in the Whispering Woods).

return_haven.description: The apprentice is free. Report to Captain Valerius in Haven.

objectives.text: Tell Captain Valerius the apprentice is safe.

completed.description: The apprentice was brought back to Haven safely.

quests.title: The Renegade's Bargain
quests.summary: Renegade Silas offers a deal: turn him in to Captain Valerius, take his hush money, or help him remove the Captain.

heroic.label: Arrest Silas & Turn Him Over to the Guard

pragmatic.label: Accept Silas' Bribe & Misdirect the Patrol

villainous.label: Ally with Silas & Eliminate Captain Valerius

confront_silas.description: Decide the fate of Renegade Silas.

completed.description: The bargain with Silas has reached its final resolution.

quests.title: The Whispering Monoliths
quests.summary: Explore the ancient stone monoliths scattered through the wilderness. This quest has no time limit.

examine_stones.description: Chart the ancient monoliths when convenient.

completed.description: The monolith runes have been recorded.
